rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a student in the second year of a course or school.

example.english: My older sister is a sophomore.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa1 ze1 hai6 ji6 nin4 kap1 saang1

rows.jyutping: daai6 hok6 ji6 nin4 kap1 hok6 saang1
rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a second-year university undergraduate rather than a secondary-school student.

example.english: My cousin is a university sophomore.
example.traditional: 我表弟係大學二年級學生。
example.jyutping: ngo5 biu2 dai6 hai6 daai6 hok6 ji6 nin4 kap1 hok6 saang1
